abstract.text: On-device face recognition with fused liveness and TrueDepth anti-spoofing.

topicSections.title: Stored verification transactions and offline replay

inlineContent.text: YEOFR recognises an enrolled user from the front camera and rejects everyone
else, fusing three signals into one trust decision: face recognition, a
liveness CNN, and TrueDepth. Recognition itself needs a real device — the
package builds and runs in the simulator, but the engine is inert there.
the engine, the camera, the fused-trust pipeline, the identity gate, and
tracker persistence, and exposes two streams:
that fills the identity’s 25-sample foundation slot. Your app keeps the
camera and the UI and drives the recipe once per frame; the recipe decides
which frames to bank, the pose order, when the capture is complete, when it
has failed, and when it is too dark to enrol.
